Card Features →

On this page

Starters ​

Ready-made scenes and parts for the Astrometrics card. Copy one into your card and change anything: nothing refers back to the starter.

  • In the Astrometrics Studio, the Starters tab adds them with a few settings (a part's name, its centre, its size) and shows the YAML first. A scene replaces the card's scene or merges into it; a part adds itself next to what is there.
  • Here, each one is a live card with its default settings. Copy its YAML into a card, or into the YAML tab of the Studio.

A part is sized for where it goes: at its real size when the scene names its units (km, au, ly), sized to fit the scene when it is in scene units (Scale: Units). The live cards here show each part on its own, at its own sizes.

A part's ids start with its name and an underscore (planet_body, planet_orbit), so two of the same part need two names. Its centre is a point of your scene (sun) or coordinates (0, 0, 0); with coordinates, the part adds a point of its own there (planet_centre).

Scenes ​

Galaxy with territories ​

A galaxy disc with its core, Federation and Borg space as see-through volumes, crossing beams, a planet with an away team (it appears as you fly in) and a route between two stars.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: core, xyz: [0, 0, 0], label: GALACTIC CORE, style: title }
  - { id: sagittarius, polar: [45, 300], label: Sagittarius Arm, style: major }
  - { id: federation, polar: [75, 135], alt: 22, label: FEDERATION, style: major, color: var(--lcars-blue) }
  - { id: borg, polar: [30, 345], alt: 44, label: BORG SPACE, style: major, color: var(--lcars-green) }
  - { id: talos, polar: [52, 310], marker: dot, label: Talos IV, style: tiny, max_distance: 200 }
  - { id: vega, polar: [64, 160], marker: triangle, label: Vega, style: minor }
  - { id: nimbus, polar: [72, 236], alt: 12, marker: reticle, label: NIMBUS III, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: planet } }
  - id: away
    latlon: [10, 40]
    object: planet
    alt: 0.3
    marker: dot
    label: AWAY TEAM
    style: tiny
    color: var(--lcars-orange)
    max_distance: 100
objects:
  - type: grid
    shape: disc
    radius: 100
    pattern: polar
    line_spacing: 10
    spoke_count: 36
    major: { row_interval: 3 }
    ring_labels: { step: 10, radius: 106 }
  - { type: ring, radius: 100, width: 3, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary }
  - type: volume
    id: federation_space
    shape: sector
    radius: [55, 95]
    angle: [100, 170]
    height: [-6, 18]
    cells: { ring: 10, angle: 10, layer: 8 }
    color: var(--lcars-blue)
    tap_action: { action: fly-to }
  - { type: volume, shape: sector, radius: [18, 42], angle: [330, 360], height: [0, 40], color: var(--lcars-green) }
  - { type: glow, at: core, size: 70 }
  - { type: beam, from: [-180, 0, 0], to: [180, 0, 0] }
  - { type: beam, from: [0, 0, -180], to: [0, 0, 180] }
  - { type: sphere, id: planet, at: nimbus, radius: 6, spin: 8, max_distance: 100 }
  - { type: ring, at: nimbus, radius: 10, inclination: 20, width: 1.5, max_distance: 100 }
  - { type: path, points: [talos, vega], arc: 12, dash: [6, 4], color: var(--lcars-orange) }
camera:
  view: galaxy
  views:
    galaxy: { target: core, yaw: 20, tilt: 35, distance: 280 }
    map: { target: core, tilt: 90, distance: 300 }
    planet: { target: nimbus, yaw: 60, tilt: 20, distance: 40 }
backdrop: { stars: { count: 2500 } }

Sector map ​

A flat lettered grid seen from straight above, territories filled cell by cell; the tilt is locked, so a drag pans the map.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: ufp, cell: AG4, object: sectors, label: UNITED FEDERATION OF PLANETS, style: major }
  - { id: sb10, cell: AJ2, object: sectors, offset: [8, 0, 12], marker: triangle, label: Starbase 10 }
  - { id: achernar, cell: AN3, object: sectors, marker: diamond, label: Achernar }
  - { id: qualor, cell: AL6, object: sectors, marker: dot, label: Qualor, style: tiny, max_distance: 1300 }
objects:
  - type: grid
    id: sectors
    shape: plane
    size: [1200, 600]
    line_spacing: 40
    axis_labels: { columns: letters, rows: numbers, column_start: AD }
    cells:
      - { from: AF3, to: AH6, color: var(--lcars-blue), opacity: 0.3, shade: 0.4, edges: true }
      - { from: AL2, to: AO5, color: var(--lcars-green), opacity: 0.25, shade: 0.4 }
      - { from: AL9, to: AP12, color: var(--lcars-red), opacity: 0.3, shade: 0.4 }
camera:
  view: map
  limits: { tilt: [90, 90] }
  views: { map: { target: [0, 0, 0], tilt: 90, distance: 1250, projection: orthographic } }

Sky dome: the sun and moon ​

A dome over your home with the sun and moon where they are now and today's tracks across the sky, from your Home Assistant location.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: sun, sky: sun, object: sky, marker: reticle, label: SOL }
  - { id: moon, sky: moon, object: sky, marker: moon_phase, label: LUNA }
  - { id: north, altaz: [0, 0], object: sky, label: 'N', style: major, overlap: true }
  - { id: east, altaz: [90, 0], object: sky, label: E, style: major, overlap: true }
  - { id: south, altaz: [180, 0], object: sky, label: S, style: major, overlap: true }
  - { id: west, altaz: [270, 0], object: sky, label: W, style: major, overlap: true }
objects:
  - { type: grid, id: sky, shape: dome, radius: 100, pattern: both, line_spacing_deg: 15 }
  - { type: ring, radius: 100, width: 3, color: theme:colors.ui.primary }
  - { type: path, sky: sun, object: sky, dash: [6, 4], color: var(--lcars-yellow) }
  - { type: path, sky: moon, object: sky, dash: [6, 4], color: var(--lcars-blue) }
camera:
  view: horizon
  views:
    horizon: { target: [0, 15, 0], yaw: 180, tilt: 28, distance: 260 }
    zenith: { target: [0, 0, 0], tilt: 90, distance: 260 }

Federation map ​

The Alpha and Beta Quadrant powers as territories on a disc, their capitals, the Romulan Neutral Zone and a route from Earth to Qo'noS.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: federation, polar: [60, 165], alt: 14, label: UNITED FEDERATION OF PLANETS, style: major, color: var(--lcars-blue) }
  - { id: klingon, polar: [80, 45], alt: 14, label: KLINGON EMPIRE, style: major, color: var(--lcars-red) }
  - { id: romulan, polar: [90, 320], alt: 14, label: ROMULAN STAR EMPIRE, style: major, color: var(--lcars-green) }
  - { id: cardassian, polar: [85, 235], alt: 14, label: CARDASSIAN UNION, style: major, color: var(--lcars-orange) }
  - { id: earth, polar: [45, 170], marker: reticle, label: Earth, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: sol } }
  - { id: vulcan, polar: [52, 150], marker: dot, label: Vulcan, style: tiny }
  - { id: qonos, polar: [80, 40], marker: diamond, label: Qo'noS }
  - { id: romulus, polar: [95, 325], marker: diamond, label: Romulus }
  - { id: cardassia, polar: [90, 230], marker: diamond, label: Cardassia Prime }
  - { id: neutral_zone, polar: [60, 330], label: NEUTRAL ZONE, style: tiny, color: var(--lcars-green) }
objects:
  - type: grid
    shape: disc
    radius: 130
    pattern: polar
    line_spacing: 10
    spoke_count: 36
    major: { row_interval: 3 }
    opacity: 0.6
  - { type: ring, radius: 130, width: 2, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary }
  - type: volume
    id: federation_space
    shape: sector
    radius: [25, 75]
    angle: [130, 200]
    height: [-4, 6]
    color: var(--lcars-blue)
    tap_action: { action: fly-to }
  - type: volume
    id: klingon_space
    shape: sector
    radius: [50, 110]
    angle: [15, 75]
    height: [-4, 6]
    color: var(--lcars-red)
    tap_action: { action: fly-to }
  - type: volume
    id: romulan_space
    shape: sector
    radius: [65, 120]
    angle: [295, 350]
    height: [-4, 6]
    color: var(--lcars-green)

  - type: volume

    radius: [60, 115]
    angle: [210, 255]
    height: [-4, 6]

  - { type: ring, radius: 62, arc: [295, 350], width: 2, dash: [6, 4], color: var(--lcars-green) }
  - { type: path, points: [earth, qonos], arc: 10, dash: { pattern: [6, 4], speed: 20 }, color: var(--lcars-orange) }
  - { type: glow, at: [0, 0, 0], size: 40, opacity: 0.6 }
camera:
  view: overview
  views:
    overview: { target: [0, 0, -10], yaw: 200, tilt: 50, distance: 350 }

    sol: { target: earth, yaw: 220, tilt: 35, distance: 80 }
backdrop: { stars: { count: 1500 } }

Starbase approach ​

The built-in refit Constitution-class starship on its way into Earth Spacedock through the space doors, with its bridge and nacelles marked and the approach lane drawn. To scale: the ship is 305 m long, Spacedock about 5.5 km tall and its doors 700 m wide.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: ship_centre, xyz: [0, 129, 41] }
  - id: ship_name
    at: ship_centre
    offset: [0, 12, 0]
    label: USS ENTERPRISE
    style: major
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: ship }
  - { id: bridge, object: ship, part: bridge, marker: dot, label: BRIDGE, style: tiny }
  - { id: port, object: ship, part: nacelle_port, marker: dot, label: PORT NACELLE, style: tiny }
  - { id: starboard, object: ship, part: nacelle_starboard, marker: dot, label: STARBOARD NACELLE, style: tiny }
  - { id: doors, xyz: [0, 62, -9], marker: dot, label: SPACE DOORS, style: minor }
  - { id: dock, at: doors, offset: [0, 50, 0], label: SPACEDOCK, style: major, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: starbase } }
objects:
  - type: model
    id: ship
    src: builtin:constitution_class_refit
    at: ship_centre
    size: 26.7
    rotation: [0, 180, 0]
    scan: { period: 6 }
    animation: all
  - { type: model, id: spacedock, src: builtin:earth_spacedock, at: [0, -110, -110], size: 480, material: original }
  - { type: path, points: [ship_centre, doors], dash: { pattern: [4, 6], speed: -30 }, color: var(--lcars-orange) }
camera:
  view: approach
  views:
    approach: { target: [0, 90, 15], yaw: 125, tilt: 20, distance: 300 }
    starbase: { target: dock, yaw: 200, tilt: 30, distance: 420 }
    ship: { target: ship_centre, yaw: 140, tilt: 25, distance: 50 }
backdrop: { stars: { count: 2000 } }

Deep Space 9 ​

The built-in Deep Space 9 station with Ops, the Promenade and its docking pylons marked, the Bajoran wormhole off its bow and Bajor below. Tap a name to fly to it.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: ds9_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - id: ds9_name
    at: ds9_centre
    offset: [0, 70, 0]
    label: DEEP SPACE 9
    style: major
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: station }
  - { id: ops, object: ds9, part: ops, marker: dot, label: OPS, style: minor, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: ops } }
  - { id: promenade, object: ds9, part: promenade, marker: dot, label: PROMENADE, style: tiny }
  - { id: habitat, object: ds9, part: habitat_ring, marker: dot, label: HABITAT RING, style: tiny }
  - { id: pylon1, object: ds9, part: upper_pylon_1, marker: dot, label: UPPER PYLON 1, style: tiny }
  - { id: pylon2, object: ds9, part: upper_pylon_2, marker: dot, label: UPPER PYLON 2, style: tiny }
  - { id: pylon3, object: ds9, part: upper_pylon_3, marker: dot, label: UPPER PYLON 3, style: tiny }
  - { id: wormhole, xyz: [0, 10, 300], label: BAJORAN WORMHOLE, style: minor, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: wormhole } }
  - { id: bajor, xyz: [-160, -260, -40] }
  - { id: bajor_name, at: bajor, offset: [0, 30, 125], label: BAJOR, style: minor }
objects:
  - { type: model, id: ds9, src: builtin:deep_space_nine, at: ds9_centre, size: 100, material: original }
  - { type: glow, at: wormhole, size: 90, color: var(--lcars-blue) }
  - { type: glow, at: wormhole, size: 40, color: var(--lcards-moonlight) }
  - { type: ring, at: wormhole, radius: 26, rotation: [90, 0, 0], spin: 40, dash: [2, 4], width: 1.5, color: var(--lcars-blue) }
  - type: sphere
    at: bajor
    radius: 120
    fill: { effect: { preset: terran } }
    line_spacing_deg: 30
    line_width: 0.5
    opacity: 0.3
    spin: 3
camera:
  view: station
  views:
    station: { target: ds9_centre, yaw: 30, tilt: 10, distance: 190 }
    ops: { target: ops, yaw: 50, tilt: 25, distance: 70 }
    wormhole: { target: wormhole, yaw: 150, tilt: 8, distance: 120 }
    sector: { target: [0, -40, 120], yaw: 60, tilt: 20, distance: 520 }
backdrop: { stars: { count: 2500 } }

Bajoran wormhole ​

The Bajoran wormhole as the station displays draw it: the mouth (a swirl of gas round a warm heart in the realistic look, an entrance disc and funnel in the diagram) and, diagram only, its inside: the pipeline, the negative CTL region, the ring singularity, the positive CTL region, the point singularity and the verteron membrane. Switch the card's look to see one or the other. Tap a name to fly to it. With a power entity (0 to 100) the mouth opens and the regions wobble with it.

SettingDefaultNotes
Power entity (optional)``A number from 0 to 100: the mouth opens with it.
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: mouth, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - id: name
    at: mouth
    offset: [0, 14, 0]
    label: BAJORAN WORMHOLE
    style: major

objects:
  - type: grid
    id: wormhole_mouth
    shape: well
    well: { shape: trumpet, throat: 0.1 }
    at: mouth
    face: wormhole_down
    radius: 9
    depth: 7
    line_spacing_deg: 20
    color: var(--lcars-blue)
    scan: { period: 4 }
    look: diagram
    deform: [{ type: twist, angle: 60, anchor: top }, { type: wobble, lobes: 0, waves: 2, period: 3, amplitude: 0.06 }]
  - type: ring
    id: wormhole_ring
    at: mouth
    face: wormhole_down
    radius: 15.75
    dash: { pattern: [6, 10], speed: 40 }
    width: 2
    spin: 90
    look: diagram
  - { type: glow, id: wormhole_glow, at: mouth, color: var(--lcars-blue), size: 18, look: diagram }
  - type: grid
    id: wormhole_funnel
    shape: well

    at: mouth
    face: wormhole_down
    radius: 13.5
    depth: 7
    line_width: 0
    edges: false
    look: realistic
    fill:

        turbulence: 0.8

Utopia Planitia yards ​

Three drydocks of the Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards in orbit over Mars (its USGS Viking map), a Galaxy-class starship in the first. Tap a drydock to fly to it.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: mars, xyz: [0, -200, 0] }
  - { id: mars_name, at: mars, offset: [0, 40, 200], label: MARS, style: major }
  - { id: dock1, xyz: [-70, 30, 20] }
  - id: dock1_name
    at: dock1
    offset: [0, 14, 0]
    marker: reticle
    label: DRYDOCK 1
    style: minor
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: dock1 }
  - { id: dock2, xyz: [0, 38, 0] }
  - id: dock2_name
    at: dock2
    offset: [0, 14, 0]
    marker: reticle
    label: DRYDOCK 2
    style: minor
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: dock2 }
  - { id: dock3, xyz: [70, 30, -20] }
  - id: dock3_name
    at: dock3
    offset: [0, 14, 0]
    marker: reticle
    label: DRYDOCK 3
    style: minor
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: dock3 }
objects:
  - type: sphere
    id: mars_body
    at: mars
    radius: 190
    image: builtin:mars_viking
    line_spacing_deg: 30
    line_width: 0.5
    opacity: 0.3
    spin: 2
  - { type: model, id: dock1_frame, src: builtin:utopia_planitia_drydock, at: dock1, size: 40, material: original }
  - { type: model, id: dock1_ship, src: builtin:galaxy_class, at: dock1, size: 33.8, scan: { period: 6 } }
  - { type: model, id: dock2_frame, src: builtin:utopia_planitia_drydock, at: dock2, size: 40, material: original }
  - { type: model, id: dock3_frame, src: builtin:utopia_planitia_drydock, at: dock3, size: 40, material: original }
camera:
  view: yards
  views:
    yards: { target: [0, 20, 0], yaw: 20, tilt: 22, distance: 260 }
    dock1: { target: dock1, yaw: 35, tilt: 20, distance: 80 }
    dock2: { target: dock2, yaw: 35, tilt: 20, distance: 80 }
    dock3: { target: dock3, yaw: 35, tilt: 20, distance: 80 }
backdrop: { stars: { count: 2000 } }

Borg encounter ​

A Borg cube with its green halo bearing down on the built-in Galaxy-class starship, its tractor beam locked on. Tap a name to fly to it.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: cube, xyz: [0, 0, -20] }
  - { id: cube_name, at: cube, offset: [0, 32, 0], label: BORG CUBE, style: major, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: cube } }
  - { id: ship, xyz: [0, 4, 70] }
  - id: ship_name
    at: ship
    offset: [0, 10, 0]
    label: USS ENTERPRISE
    style: minor
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: ship }
  - { id: emitter, xyz: [0, 2, 0] }
objects:
  - { type: glow, at: cube, size: 110, color: var(--lcards-green-medium), opacity: 0.45 }
  - { type: cube, id: borg, at: cube, size: 40, spin: 3, rotation: [8, 25, 0] }
  - { type: model, id: hull, src: builtin:galaxy_class, at: ship, size: 22, rotation: [0, 160, 0], scan: { period: 5 } }
  - { type: beam, from: emitter, to: ship, width: 10, color: var(--lcards-green-medium), pulse: true }
camera:
  view: encounter
  views:
    encounter: { target: [0, 0, 20], yaw: 120, tilt: 15, distance: 170 }
    cube: { target: cube, yaw: 30, tilt: 20, distance: 90 }
    ship: { target: ship, yaw: 150, tilt: 20, distance: 45 }
backdrop: { stars: { count: 2500 } }

Solar system (real positions) ​

The Sun, the planets, Pluto, Ceres and the major moons in km, where they really are today and moving a day a second: real orbits, sizes, tilts and spins, Saturn's rings, the asteroid and Kuiper belts. Tap a planet to fly to it; the time slider runs the date faster, slower or back.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: sun, xyz: [0, 0, 0], label: SOL, style: major }
  - { id: mercury, body: mercury, marker: dot, label: MERCURY, style: tiny }
  - { id: venus, body: venus, marker: dot, label: VENUS, style: tiny }
  - { id: earth, body: earth, marker: dot, label: EARTH, style: minor, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: earth } }
  - { id: mars, body: mars, marker: dot, label: MARS, style: minor, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: mars } }
  - { id: ceres, body: ceres, marker: dot, label: CERES, style: tiny }
  - { id: jupiter, body: jupiter, marker: dot, label: JUPITER, style: minor, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: jupiter } }
  - { id: saturn, body: saturn, marker: dot, label: SATURN, style: minor, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: saturn } }
  - { id: uranus, body: uranus, marker: dot, label: URANUS, style: tiny }
  - { id: neptune, body: neptune, marker: dot, label: NEPTUNE, style: tiny, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: neptune } }
  - { id: pluto, body: pluto, marker: dot, label: PLUTO, style: tiny, tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: pluto } }
  - { id: moon, body: moon, label: LUNA, style: tiny, max_distance: 19220000 }
  - { id: phobos, body: phobos, label: PHOBOS, style: tiny, max_distance: 468750 }
  - { id: deimos, body: deimos, label: DEIMOS, style: tiny, max_distance: 1172850 }
  - { id: io, body: io, label: IO, style: tiny, max_distance: 21090000 }
  - { id: europa, body: europa, label: EUROPA, style: tiny, max_distance: 33555000 }
  - { id: ganymede, body: ganymede, label: GANYMEDE, style: tiny, max_distance: 53520000 }
  - { id: callisto, body: callisto, label: CALLISTO, style: tiny, max_distance: 94135000 }

Galaxy to station at true scale ​

A galaxy in light years with the Sol system in km inside it, 26,000 light years from the core: tap SOL and dive from the galaxy to the planets, Earth and Deep Space 9, all at their real sizes and distances, with the planets where they are today.

Star Trek galaxy ​

The Milky Way in light years cut into the four quadrants (the Alpha/Beta line runs from Sol to the core), with the Federation, the Klingon, Romulan and Cardassian empires, the Dominion and the Borg, the Bajoran wormhole to the Gamma Quadrant, Voyager's route home from Ocampa and the Great Barrier. Fly in to Sol for Federation space: Vulcan, Andoria and Tellar at their real stars (40 Eridani, Procyon, 61 Cygni), the Klingon, Romulan and Cardassian capitals at the distances the reference charts give. The galaxy view sizes the empires to be seen, so the two scales do not overlay exactly.

YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card

Parts ​

Each part on its own card, at its default centre. In the Studio, give it a point of your scene as its centre.

Planet with moons ​

A planet orbiting a centre point on its own ring, with up to four moons going round it. Tap the planet to fly to it.

Its ids start with its name (default planet_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelPLANET
Orbits round0, 0, 0A point id (a star) or x, y, z.
Orbit radius40
Planet radius3
Moons (0 to 4)2
SurfacerockyA planet type (gas_giant, ringed_giant, ice_giant, storm_giant, clouds, lava, ice, rocky, terran), a map (builtin:mars_viking) or your own picture (/local/planet.jpg).
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: planet_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - id: planet_body
    polar: [40, 0]
    object: planet_orbit
    marker: dot
    label: PLANET
    style: minor
    tap_action: { action: fly-to }
  - { id: planet_moon1, polar: [6, 0], object: planet_moon1_orbit, marker: dot, label: MOON1, style: tiny, max_distance: 120 }
  - { id: planet_moon2, polar: [9.6, 110], object: planet_moon2_orbit, marker: dot, label: MOON2, style: tiny, max_distance: 120 }
objects:
  - type: ring
    id: planet_orbit
    at: planet_centre
    radius: 40
    spin: 5
    width: 1
    color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
    opacity: 0.6
  - type: sphere
    id: planet_globe
    at: planet_body
    radius: 3
    fill: { effect: { preset: rocky } }
    line_spacing_deg: 30
    spin: 15
  - type: ring
    id: planet_moon1_orbit
    at: planet_body
    radius: 6
    spin: 36
    width: 1
    dash: [3, 3]
    opacity: 0.5
    max_distance: 120
  - { type: sphere, id: planet_moon1_globe, at: planet_moon1, radius: 0.75, line_spacing_deg: 45, max_distance: 120 }
  - type: ring
    id: planet_moon2_orbit
    at: planet_body
    radius: 9.6
    spin: 22
    width: 1
    dash: [3, 3]
    opacity: 0.5
    max_distance: 120
  - { type: sphere, id: planet_moon2_globe, at: planet_moon2, radius: 0.75, line_spacing_deg: 45, max_distance: 120 }

Asteroid belt ​

A band of rocks going round a centre, the inner ones faster, lit from the centre as by its star, with a label on its edge.

Its ids start with its name (default belt_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelASTEROID BELT
Centre0, 0, 0A point id (a star) or x, y, z.
Radius65
Width8
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: belt_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - { id: belt_label, at: belt_centre, offset: [0, 0, -73], label: ASTEROID BELT, style: tiny }
objects:
  - type: belt
    id: belt_rocks
    at: belt_centre
    radius: [61, 69]
    count: 900
    size: [0.2, 1.3]
    period: 60
    colors: [var(--lcards-gray-light), var(--lcards-gray-medium), var(--lcards-yellow-dark)]

Asteroid ​

One asteroid with lumps and craters, tumbling, lit from its star, with a label above it. Tap it to fly to it.

Its ids start with its name (default asteroid_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelASTEROID
Where30, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Lit from0, 0, 0A point id (its star) or x, y, z.
Size8
Shape (any whole number)4
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: asteroid_centre, xyz: [30, 0, 0] }
  - { id: asteroid_body, at: asteroid_centre, label: ASTEROID, style: minor, offset: [0, 6.4, 0], tap_action: { action: fly-to } }
objects: [{ type: asteroid, id: asteroid_rock, at: asteroid_centre, size: 8, seed: 4, light: [0, 0, 0] }]

Comet ​

A comet on an orbit centred off its star, so it swings in close and out far. Its tails point away from the star and it grows and brightens near it (activity.mode: distance). Tap it to fly to it.

Its ids start with its name (default comet_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelCOMET
Star0, 0, 0A point id (a star) or x, y, z.
Closest to the star25
Farthest from the star175
Seconds per orbit36
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: comet_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - { id: comet_body, polar: [100, 270], object: comet_orbit, label: COMET, style: tiny, tap_action: { action: fly-to } }
objects:
  - type: ring
    id: comet_orbit
    at: [75, 0, 0]
    radius: 100
    spin: 10
    width: 1
    color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
    opacity: 0.4
  - type: comet
    id: comet_comet
    at: comet_body
    light: comet_centre
    nucleus: { size: 2 }
    tail: { length: 90 }
    coma: { size: 8.33 }
    activity: { mode: distance, range: [25, 175] }

Nebula field ​

A slowly drifting body of gas (render: volume, so the camera can fly into it) with drawn-out clouds, a pale core and a dust lane, a veil of lighter puffs, a soft glow at the heart and a label.

Its ids start with its name (default nebula_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelNEBULA
Centre0, 10, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Radius40
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points: [{ id: nebula_centre, xyz: [0, 10, 0] }, { id: nebula_heart, at: nebula_centre, label: NEBULA, style: major }]
objects:
  - type: nebula
    id: nebula_clouds
    at: nebula_heart
    render: volume
    radius: 40
    count: 8
    seed: 7
    drift: 0.5
    stretch: 0.4
    dust: { count: 1 }
    core: { color: var(--lcars-ice) }
  - type: nebula
    id: nebula_veil
    at: nebula_heart
    radius: 24
    count: 6
    seed: 23
    drift: 0.8
    colors: [var(--lcars-violet), var(--lcars-blue)]
  - { type: glow, id: nebula_glow, at: nebula_heart, size: 20, opacity: 0.7 }

Badlands (Deep Space Nine) ​

The Badlands as Deep Space Nine drew them (nebula preset: badlands): a floor and a ceiling of liquid fire in yellow, orange and red, an orange band glowing in the gap between them and fire columns, thick and thin, standing from the floor to the ceiling. Fly the camera into the gap. Every key of the preset can be set on the nebula to change it.

Its ids start with its name (default badlands_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelBADLANDS
Centre0, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Width500
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points: [{ id: badlands_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }, { id: badlands_heart, at: badlands_centre, label: BADLANDS, style: major }]
objects: [{ type: nebula, id: badlands_plasma, at: badlands_heart, preset: badlands, size: [500, 140, 500] }]

Badlands (Voyager) ​

The Badlands as Voyager drew them (nebula preset: badlands_voyager): a floor and a ceiling of peach and mauve gas with a pale band between, held pink lightning columns crawling from the floor to the ceiling, and strikes that flash in the gap and light the gas round them. Fly the camera into the gap. Every key of the preset can be set on the nebula to change it.

Its ids start with its name (default badlands_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelBADLANDS
Centre0, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Width500
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points: [{ id: badlands_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }, { id: badlands_heart, at: badlands_centre, label: BADLANDS, style: major }]
objects: [{ type: nebula, id: badlands_plasma, at: badlands_heart, preset: badlands_voyager, size: [500, 160, 500] }]

The Nexus ​

The Nexus as Generations drew it (nebula preset: nexus): a white-hot ribbon waving across space, its waves running along it, a wake of pink and red gas streaming out behind it, and small discharges crawling off it and lighting the gas. Set travel to orbit to send it round the centre on a wide orbit, its wake trailing behind. Every key of the preset can be set on the nebula to change it.

Its ids start with its name (default nexus_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelNEXUS
Centre0, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Length2000
Travelstill
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points: [{ id: nexus_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }, { id: nexus_heart, at: nexus_centre, label: NEXUS, style: major }]
objects: [{ type: nebula, id: nexus_ribbon, at: nexus_heart, preset: nexus, size: [2000, 500, 500] }]

Crystalline Entity ​

The Crystalline Entity ("Datalore", "Silicon Avatar"): a crystalline object 3 km tall, turning slowly about its glowing spine, its core pulsing. With a ship, a Galaxy-class starship (the Enterprise of both episodes) stands off its side at the same scale (642.5 m against 3 km), and with the beam the entity's core fires on it. Change the crystal colour on the object (var(--lcars-african-violet) for the lavender of the show).

Its ids start with its name (default entity_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelCRYSTALLINE ENTITY
Centre0, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Height3000
Ship for scalebeam
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: entity_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - { id: entity_core, at: entity_centre }
  - { id: entity_tag, at: entity_core, offset: [0, 1680, 0], label: CRYSTALLINE ENTITY, style: major }
  - { id: entity_ship_at, at: entity_core, offset: [-2100, -90, 300], label: USS ENTERPRISE, style: minor }
objects:
  - { type: crystalline, id: entity_crystal, at: entity_core, size: 3000, spin: 2 }
  - { type: model, id: entity_ship, src: builtin:galaxy_class, at: entity_ship_at, size: 642 }
  - { type: beam, id: entity_beam, from: entity_core, to: entity_ship_at, width: 10, color: var(--lcards-moonlight), pulse: true }

Wormhole ​

The Bajoran wormhole as the station displays draw it. Its mouth is a swirl of gas round a warm heart in the realistic look, an entrance disc and funnel in the diagram. Past it, diagram only, the inside runs along +x: a pipeline of twisted strands, the negative CTL region, the ring singularity, the positive CTL region and the point singularity opening into the verteron membrane. With a power entity (0 to 100) the mouth opens and the regions wobble with it.

Its ids start with its name (default bajoran_).

SettingDefaultNotes
Mouth0, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z. The inside runs along +x from here.
Length70
Power entity (optional)``A number from 0 to 100: the mouth opens with it.

Sector volume set ​

Three territories side by side round a centre, each a see-through volume of cells in its own colour with its name above it. Tap one to fly to it.

Its ids start with its name (default zone_).

SettingDefaultNotes
Centre0, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Inner radius30
Outer radius80
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: zone_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - { id: zone_a, at: zone_centre, offset: [27.5, 16, -47.6], label: TERRITORY A, style: major, color: var(--lcars-blue) }
  - { id: zone_b, at: zone_centre, offset: [54.2, 16, 9.6], label: TERRITORY B, style: major, color: var(--lcars-red) }
  - { id: zone_c, at: zone_centre, offset: [9.6, 16, 54.2], label: TERRITORY C, style: major, color: var(--lcars-green) }
objects:
  - type: volume
    id: zone_a_space
    at: zone_centre
    shape: sector
    radius: [30, 80]
    angle: [0, 60]
    height: [-4, 10]
    cells: { ring: 10, angle: 10, layer: 7 }
    color: var(--lcars-blue)
    tap_action: { action: fly-to }
  - type: volume
    id: zone_b_space
    at: zone_centre
    shape: sector
    radius: [30, 80]
    angle: [70, 130]
    height: [-4, 10]
    cells: { ring: 10, angle: 10, layer: 7 }
    color: var(--lcars-red)
    tap_action: { action: fly-to }
  - type: volume
    id: zone_c_space
    at: zone_centre
    shape: sector
    radius: [30, 80]
    angle: [140, 200]
    height: [-4, 10]
    cells: { ring: 10, angle: 10, layer: 7 }
    color: var(--lcars-green)
    tap_action: { action: fly-to }

Starbase ​

A built-in starbase model (Deep Space 9, Earth Spacedock or a Utopia Planitia drydock) at a point, with its name and main parts labelled; far away a starbase marker stands in for it. Tap the name to fly to it.

Its ids start with its name (default starbase_).

SettingDefaultNotes
LabelDEEP SPACE 9
Modeldeep_space_ninedeep_space_nine, earth_spacedock or utopia_planitia_drydock.
At0, 0, 0A point id or x, y, z.
Size (its largest extent)60
YAML
yaml
type: custom:lcards-astrometrics-card
height: 400
points:
  - { id: starbase_centre, xyz: [0, 0, 0] }
  - id: starbase_name
    at: starbase_centre
    offset: [0, 42, 0]
    label: DEEP SPACE 9
    style: minor
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: starbase_view }
  - { id: starbase_ops, object: starbase_station, part: ops, marker: dot, label: OPS, style: tiny, max_distance: 360 }
  - id: starbase_promenade
    object: starbase_station
    part: promenade
    marker: dot
    label: PROMENADE
    style: tiny
    max_distance: 360
  - id: starbase_docking_ring
    object: starbase_station
    part: docking_ring
    marker: dot
    label: DOCKING RING
    style: tiny
    max_distance: 360
  - id: starbase_far
    at: starbase_centre
    marker: starbase
    min_distance: 720
    tap_action: { action: fly-to, view: starbase_view }
objects:
  - type: model
    id: starbase_station
    src: builtin:deep_space_nine
    at: starbase_centre
    size: 60
    material: original
    max_distance: 720
camera: { views: { starbase_view: { target: starbase_centre, yaw: 30, tilt: 15, distance: 120 } } }

Star Trek: minor powers ​

Where the Star Trek galaxy's places come from ​

The Star Trek galaxy and its parts follow what is recorded: what was said on screen, the published reference charts (Star Trek: Star Charts and Stellar Cartography: The Starfleet Reference Library, as summarised on Memory Alpha), and the star charts seen on screen that were drawn from them.

  • Quadrants: two lines through the galactic core, one of them through Sol. Alpha is the half of Sol's side at galactic longitude 0 to 180 degrees (left of the line from Sol to the core, seen from above), Beta the other half; Gamma and Delta lie across the core.
  • Homeworlds at real stars sit at those stars' real positions: Vulcan at 40 Eridani (16 ly, in Beta), Andoria at Procyon (11 ly, Beta), Tellar at 61 Cygni (11 ly, Alpha). Alpha Centauri, Wolf 359, Vega and Altair are there as well.
  • Other worlds sit within the distances on record: Qo'noS over 100 ly from Sol in Beta, Romulus in Beta past the Neutral Zone, Bajor 5.25 ly from Cardassia in Alpha, Ferenginar 55 ly from Cardassia and 60 from Bajor, the far end of the Bajoran wormhole 4.72 ly from Idran, Idran about 70,000 ly from Bajor and Ocampa about 70,000 ly from Earth, the Dominion 40,000 to 50,000 ly from the core, the Great Barrier about 15,000 ly across. Sol is 26,000 ly from the core.
  • Two scales: the galaxy view draws the empires as regions sized after the Federation's 8,000 light years, so they can be seen; the capitals are all within about 120 ly of Sol, so they appear only in the close-ups (FEDERATION, SOL NEIGHBOURS). The two do not overlay exactly. Region outlines and the places without a recorded position are our own.
